description: Resends the confirmation letter to an unconfirmed email. If the address is already confirmed — 409; if you call too often — 429 (wait for cooldown).

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: notification_email_resend
title: Resend confirmation code
